remarks: Charming Two-Bedroom Townhouse-Style Condo in the Heart of New Canaan  Discover the perfect blend of convenience and comfort in this well-appointed two-bedroom townhouse-style condo, ideally situated in the heart of New Canaan. Just minutes from the train, shops, restaurants, and all that downtown has to offer, this home is also directly across from picturesque Mead Park and its playground.  The main level features a spacious living room and a beautifully updated kitchen, complete with granite countertops, white cabinetry, and stainless-steel appliances. Upstairs, you'll find two generously sized bedrooms with ample closet space and a full bath.  Enjoy the best of in-town living with easy access to parks, entertainment, and commuter options. Don't miss this fantastic opportunity to own in one of New Canaan's most sought-after locations! Reserved Parking spot #12. Unit comes with storage unit 12 in lower storage area.  Electric Bill is not included in the common charges.
